title: Say Enigma na Arawin Trono
intro: Sakey a makapanyarin monarka, ya abendisyonan na ekstraordinaryon pananguley, so nipaarap ed nikadkaduman angat a mangilalanor ed sakey a reyna a nanlapud arawin bansa. Say ari et nanggunaetan ton ipanengneng so madibinon pakayari tan kakabatan, ya angigapo na sakey ya agmakapanisia ya ebento ya onsumlang ed saray ganggan na panaon tan liwang. Kasin nadetermina yo ray detalye na sayan mamilagron inkagawa?
clues: Say sakey a manuley et naikdan na baleg a pakayari, kaiba lay panangontrol ed saray agnanengneng a pinalsa tan say pakayarin mangiganggan ed saray dagem.
Sayan manuley et akaawat na balita nipaakar ed sakey a mayaman a reyna ya mandadayew ed banwa, tan nandesisyon ya imbitaan tod palasyo.
Antis ya sinmabi so reyna, imbalikas na manuley so pilalek ton awiten so makapadinayew a yurongan na pakayari to manlapud arawin panarian to.
Sakey a mabiskeg a jinn so angiyopresi ya alaen to so bengatla sakbay ya ontalindeg so manuley manlapud konsilyo to.
Balet, sakey a walaan na aralem a pikakabat ed Madibinon Kasulatan so angiyopresi na mas maples a panagbawi, a nasumpal so kimey ed sakey a kirem na mata.
Nen sinmabi itan, ingganggan na manuley ya umanen so bengatla pian nasubok so inkadunong tan pakatebek na reyna no akasabi lad palasyo.

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
